svg.title: Figure 2. Superposition of elastic curves
svg.desc: Two plots of nondimensional deflection along a beam. (a) A simple span with a load P at three quarters of the span and a load P over 2 at one quarter: the two single-load elastic curves, dash-dot and dotted, add up to the solid curve for both loads. (b) A propped cantilever with a central load: the cantilever bends down under the load alone and up under the prop force alone; the prop force is the value that makes the sum zero at the prop.
